name: AI Connector Recipes by wankodo
purpose: Ready-to-follow recipes that let an AI agent build a working connector for a service without re-deriving API details from scratch. Each recipe lists the API host, endpoints, OAuth details, setup steps and known pitfalls, all verified against the provider's official documentation. Credentials are never included; every user supplies their own through their platform's secure flow.

recipes.known_blocker: Muse's custom-connector OAuth flow requires all OAuth endpoints on one issuer domain; Google's authorize endpoint (accounts.google.com) and token endpoint (oauth2.googleapis.com) span domains, so this cannot be registered there as of 2026-11-21.
Same Google OAuth cross-domain limitation as google-adsense. Google also publishes an official Analytics MCP server that authenticates with Application Default Credentials (ADC).
recipes.service: Google Analytics 4 (Analytics Data API v1beta + Admin API)
